player_prompt.intro:
I Tower of Hanoi-ah disk {num_disks} nen i khel mek.
Tower A atangin tower C ah i disk te chawi tur a ni.
Disk chawi turin, source tower leh target tower (e.g., '[A C]') tiin ziakin type rawh.
Eng ti angin, tower top a disk chauh chawi theih a ni, a chhan chu disk tam zawk chu disk tlem zawk aia pe theih loh a ni.
Tun tumah phei chuan move khat chauh submit tur a ni.

invalid_move.wrong_format: I '[source] [target]' tia chiang lovin i rawnghak che.
invalid_move.invalid_tower: Source emaw, target tower emaw i sawi dik lo.
invalid_move.empty_tower: Tower awm lo aṭangin disk i la rawn thlak a.
invalid_move.same_tower: You tried to move a disk to the same tower.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Disk lian zâwk chu disk têah i dah a.

game_action.moved: I disk {disk} chu {source} atangin {target} ah kan neih.

outcome.win: Ka lawm e! Hanoi kulh thuziak chu i solve ta a ni.
outcome.turn_limit: Turn limit a thleng ta. Tower C-a disk i dah % {pct} chu dik takin i dah e.
